# fct_curated_rate_buckets

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_curated_rate_buckets` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table of the curated rates algorithm output. Each row represents a single rate placed in a single bucket for a search (one row per search, request, source rate identifier, and bucket). Holds the winner and all competitors per bucket, and links back to the rates in fct_room_rates.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `curated_rate_bucket_key` | Primary Key. Composite key combining search_id, request_id, source_rate_identifier, and bucket to uniquely identify each rate in each bucket per search. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `active_filters` | Filters active when the bucket was rendered. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the advisor the bucket was rendered for. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `bucket` | The curated rate bucket the rate was placed in (e.g. nonPackage, refundable). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `canonical_room_id` | Foreign Key to dim_canonical_rooms. The canonical room the bucketed rate is for. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_winner` | True/false flag indicating whether the rate is the winning rate for the bucket. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `logged_at` | Timestamp when the bucket was logged by the front end. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `portal` | The portal the bucket was rendered in (advisor or traveler). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_id` | Identifier for the rate request the bucketed rate came from. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_rate_key` | Foreign Key to fct_room_rates. Combines request_id, supplier_id, and source_rate_identifier to join back to the rate for price and commission. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `search_id` | Identifier for the advisor search the bucket was rendered for. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `source_rate_identifier` | The rate code returned by the provider. Not globally unique; reused across hotels. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the supplier (hotel), resolved from the canonical room. >> SOURCE - Portal |
